renderings.value: Means 'apart from ~ there's nothing else,' implying the Noun is the best or most suitable choice.

The structure Nounをおいて他に〜ない is used to express that there is no substitute for the Noun, no other choice, or that the Noun is the best or the only one to choose among various options. This form is often used in praising or making strong positive comments about someone or something.
Noun + をおいて他に + Verb negative form
をおいて他に～ない: no one but X (彼をおいて他にいない).
Apart from him, there's no one else to entrust this job to.
Apart from him, there's no one else who can solve this problem.
There is no other restaurant in this area that makes delicious noodles apart from this one.
There is no other singer who could surpass her singing voice.
